fib: ______ can be defined as committing the money and other resources you have at the present into businesses, activities or assets with the expectation of deriving greater resources from them in the future.
investment

An investment can be defined as committing the money and other resources you have at the present into businesses, activities or assets with the expectation of deriving greater resources from them in the future.

Nigertel
Nigertel is a firm that is all-equity financed and has total assets of N100 million.
______ is one of the two basic factors in determining a firm's rate of earnings.
Return on equity (ROE)
Return on equity
ROE
Return on equity (ROE) is one of the two basic factors in determining a firm's rate of earnings.
______ is a summary of the profitability of the firm over a period of time, usually after one year.
income statement
The income statement is a summary of the profitability of the firm over a period of time, usually after one year.
______ is a better measure of liquidity than the current ratio for firms whose inventory is not readily convertible into cash.
quick ratio
The quick ratio is a better measure of liquidity than the current ratio for firms whose inventory is not readily convertible into cash.
______ are the last in line of all those who have claim on the assets and income of the corporation.
Residual value implies that stockholders
Residual value implies that stockholders are the last in line of all those who have claim on the assets and income of the corporation.
______ is a simple and unambiguous measure of investment return over a single period.
holding period return
The holding period return is a simple and unambiguous measure of investment return over a single period.
______ is regarded as trading on the primary market.
Trading on new issues
Trading on new issues is regarded as trading on the primary market.
______ is a measure of the effective maturity of a bond, defined as the weighted average of the times until each payments, with weights proportional to the present value of the payment.
Duration
Duration is a measure of the effective maturity of a bond, defined as the weighted average of the times until each payments, with weights proportional to the present value of the payment.
______ is a major determinant of interest rate risk on fixed-income assets.
Maturity period
Maturity period is a major determinant of interest rate risk on fixed-income assets.
______ is a security that holds the issuer under obligation to make specified payments to the holder over a period of time.
bond
A bond is a security that holds the issuer under obligation to make specified payments to the holder over a period of time.
